username.title: Username
username.description: User name (may be a template expression).

base64.title: Base64
base64.description: Base64-encoded binary data or template expression.

basic.description: HTTP Basic authentication: the credentials go with every request.

bearer.title: Bearer
bearer.description: Token sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' (may be a template expression).

base_url.title: Base Url
base_url.description: Absolute http(s) URL without a query or fragment. A relative request.url is appended to its path.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Headers sent with every request; a stage's request.headers override them by name, case-insensitively.

params.title: Params
params.description: Query parameters sent with every request, unless its URL or request.params already sets the key.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for requests that do not set request.timeout.

follow_redirects.title: Follow Redirects
follow_redirects.description: Whether requests that do not set request.allow_redirects follow redirects.

max_redirects.title: Max Redirects
max_redirects.description: Redirects a request follows at most before it fails.

proxy.title: Proxy
proxy.description: Proxy for every request (http, https, socks5 or socks5h URL); replaces the proxy environment variables.

http2.title: Http2
http2.description: Offer HTTP/2, used when the server negotiates it; the requests to that server then share one connection, 100 at a time at most.

max_connections.title: Max Connections
max_connections.description: Connections the pool opens at most; null (the default) for no limit, which leaves parallel.max_concurrency to bound them.

max_keepalive_connections.title: Max Keepalive Connections
max_keepalive_connections.description: Idle connections the pool keeps open for reuse at most; null for no limit.

ClientConfig.title: ClientConfig
ClientConfig.description:
Settings of the HTTP client all the scenario's stages share. What a stage
sets in its own request (url, headers, params, timeout, allow_redirects)
wins over them.

combinations.title: Combinations
combinations.description: Non-empty list of parameter combinations (each dict must have at least one parameter) or template expression

digest.description: HTTP Digest authentication: the credentials answer the server's challenge, which costs the first request a round trip.

files.title: Files
files.description: Files to upload from file paths.

HTTPMethod.title: HTTPMethod
HTTPMethod.description:
HTTP methods and descriptions

Methods from the following RFCs are all observed:

    * RFC 9110: HTTP Semantics, obsoletes 7231, which obsoleted 2616
    * RFC 5789: PATCH Method for HTTP

HTTPStatus.title: HTTPStatus
HTTPStatus.description:
HTTP status codes and reason phrases

Status codes from the following RFCs are all observed:

    * RFC 9110: HTTP Semantics, obsoletes 7231, which obsoleted 2616
    * RFC 6585: Additional HTTP Status Codes
    * RFC 3229: Delta encoding in HTTP
    * RFC 4918: HTTP Extensions for WebDAV, obsoletes 2518
    * RFC 5842: Binding Extensions to WebDAV
    * RFC 7238: Permanent Redirect
    * RFC 2295: Transparent Content Negotiation in HTTP
    * RFC 2774: An HTTP Extension Framework
    * RFC 7725: An HTTP Status Code to Report Legal Obstacles
    * RFC 7540: Hypertext Transfer Protocol Version 2 (HTTP/2)
    * RFC 2324: Hyper Text Coffee Pot Control Protocol (HTCPCP/1.0)
    * RFC 8297: An HTTP Status Code for Indicating Hints
    * RFC 8470: Using Early Data in HTTP

contains.title: Contains
contains.description: Substring the header value must contain.

not_contains.title: Not Contains
not_contains.description: Substring the header value must NOT contain.

matches.title: Matches
matches.description: Regex the header value must match (re.search).

not_matches.title: Not Matches
not_matches.description: Regex the header value must NOT match (re.search).

HeaderMatcher.title: HeaderMatcher
HeaderMatcher.description:
Matcher for one expected response header; at least one field must be set.
An absent header behaves as an empty string, as bodies do.

individual.title: Individual
individual.description: Parameter name mapped to list of values (single parameter per step, non-empty values) or template expression

eq.description: Equal to this JSON value (true is not 1; 1 equals 1.0).

ne.description: Not equal to this JSON value; {"ne": null} for a value that is there and not null.

ge.title: Ge
ge.description: A number greater than or equal to this.

le.title: Le
le.description: A number less than or equal to this.

contains.description: A string holding this substring, an array holding an element equal to this, or an object holding this key.

not_contains.description: A string without this substring, an array without an element equal to this, or an object without this key.

not_matches.title: Not Matches
not_matches.description: A string this regex does not match (re.search).

type.title: Type
type.description: A value of this JSON type: integer is a number written without a fraction or exponent, number any number; neither is a boolean.

length.title: Length
length.description: A string, array or object of this length (characters, elements, keys).

JMESPathMatcher.title: JMESPathMatcher
JMESPathMatcher.description:
Matcher for the value one JMESPath expression extracts from the response
body; every key given must hold. To compare with an object, give it as eq.

jmespath.title: Jmespath
jmespath.description: JMESPath expressions to extract values from response.

JMESPathSave.title: JMESPathSave
JMESPathSave.description: Save data using JMESPath expressions to extract values from response.

calls_per_sec.title: Calls Per Sec
calls_per_sec.description: Maximum number of API calls per second, shared by this stage's concurrent iterations. The limiter is per stage execution and per process: consecutive stages, other scenarios, and pytest-xdist workers each get their own budget.

max_rate_limit_delay.title: Max Rate Limit Delay
max_rate_limit_delay.description: Maximum seconds to wait when rate-limited before giving up. Defaults to 60 seconds.

foreach.title: Foreach
foreach.description: Execute request once for each parameter set in parallel.

ParallelForeachConfig.title: ParallelForeachConfig
ParallelForeachConfig.description: Execute request once for each parameter set in parallel.

calls_per_sec.title: Calls Per Sec
calls_per_sec.description: Maximum number of API calls per second, shared by this stage's concurrent iterations. The limiter is per stage execution and per process: consecutive stages, other scenarios, and pytest-xdist workers each get their own budget.

max_rate_limit_delay.title: Max Rate Limit Delay
max_rate_limit_delay.description: Maximum seconds to wait when rate-limited before giving up. Defaults to 60 seconds.

repeat.title: Repeat
repeat.description: Execute the same request N times in parallel.

ParallelRepeatConfig.title: ParallelRepeatConfig
ParallelRepeatConfig.description: Execute the same request N times in parallel.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: Regular expression searched for in the response body's text (re.search).

group.title: Group
group.description: The group to save: its number (0 for the whole match) or its name. Not set: group 1 if the pattern has groups, else the whole match.

all.title: All
all.description: Save a list holding the group of every match (re.finditer), empty when nothing matches, instead of the first match's group.

RegexCapture.title: RegexCapture
RegexCapture.description:
A save.regex entry written as an object: the pattern, which of its
groups to save, and whether from the first match or from every match.

regex.title: Regex
regex.description: A pattern per variable, searched for in the response body's text (re.search): the variable is group 1 of the first match if the pattern has groups, else the whole match. Or an object: pattern, group (a number or a name) and all (a list from every match). A pattern that does not match fails the step, unless all is set.

RegexSave.title: RegexSave
RegexSave.description:
Save what regular expressions find in the response body's text, for
bodies that are not JSON (HTML, plain text).

url.title: Url
url.description: Absolute http(s) URL, or a URL relative to client.base_url (may be a template expression), passed to httpx as written.

method.description: HTTP method: a standard verb (autocompleted) or any RFC 9110 token (e.g. PROPFIND, PURGE).
method.title: Method

params.title: Params
params.description: URL query parameters, merged into any query already in the URL and over client.params; a key in both takes the value given here.

auth.description: Authentication for this request, over the scenario's: basic, digest or bearer, a user function, or false for none.
auth.title: Auth

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds. Not set, client.timeout applies (30 by default).

allow_redirects.title: Allow Redirects
allow_redirects.description: Whether to follow redirects. Not set, client.follow_redirects applies (true by default).

contains.title: Contains
contains.description: Substrings the response body must contain.

not_contains.title: Not Contains
not_contains.description: Substrings the response body must NOT contain.

matches.title: Matches
matches.description: Regex patterns the response body must match.

not_matches.title: Not Matches
not_matches.description: Regex patterns the response body must NOT match.

verify.title: Verify
verify.description: SSL certificate verification. True (verify), False (no verification), or path to CA bundle.

cert.title: Cert
cert.description: SSL client certificate. Single file path or tuple of (cert_path, key_path).

always_run.title: Always Run
always_run.description: Execute even if a previous stage failed. A template expression is evaluated (truthiness) when the chain is aborted, against fixtures, parametrize parameters, scenario substitutions, and previously saved variables.

parallel.description: Parallel execution configuration for load/stress testing.
parallel.title: Parallel

response.title: Response
response.description: Sequential steps to process the response.

UserFunctionName.title: UserFunctionName
UserFunctionName.description: Name of the function to be called.

UserFunctionsSave.title: UserFunctionsSave
UserFunctionsSave.description: Save data using user-defined functions to process response data.

status.description: Expected HTTP status: a code (a standard one autocompleted, or any integer 100-599, e.g. 499), a class '1xx'-'5xx' (case-insensitive) matching any code in it, or a non-empty list of codes and classes, any one of which passes. A template may render to any of these forms.
status.title: Status

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Expected response headers: a string (exact match) or a matcher object (contains/not_contains/matches/not_matches) per key.

anyOf.description: Equal to this JSON value (true is not 1; 1 equals 1.0).

jmespath.title: Jmespath
jmespath.description: Assertions on the JSON response body: a JMESPath expression per key, mapped to the value it must equal (any JSON value but an object) or to a matcher object (eq, ne, gt, ge, lt, le, contains, not_contains, matches, not_matches, type, length). A missing path extracts null.

expressions.title: Expressions
expressions.description: Template expressions evaluated as boolean conditions against the context (saved variables, fixtures, substitutions). Each must be a full template expression that evaluates to a boolean. Response metadata is available as `response.*`: status, reason, headers, elapsed_ms.

VerifyStep.title: VerifyStep
VerifyStep.description: Verify HTTP response and data context.

JsonRef.description: Reference to external JSON file or JSON pointer. Use $include or $merge (preferred) or $ref. Resolved when the scenario file is loaded.

$include.description: Path to external JSON file, JSON pointer (#/path), or combined (file.json#/path). Preferred over $ref to avoid VS Code conflicts.

$merge.description: Alias for $include. Path to external JSON file, JSON pointer (#/path), or combined (file.json#/path).

$ref.description: Legacy alias for $include. May conflict with VS Code's own $ref handling.

fixtures.title: Fixtures
fixtures.description: pytest fixtures available to all stages

auth.title: Auth
auth.description: Authentication for every request: basic, digest or bearer, or a user function for a custom scheme.

client.title: client
client.description: The shared HTTP client: base URL, default headers and query parameters, timeout, redirects, proxy, HTTP/2 and connection pool.

stages.title: Stages
stages.description: Ordered list (or name-keyed mapping) of stages to execute.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor as-you-type validation. Dropped during model validation.

$include.description: Path to external JSON file, JSON pointer (#/path), or combined (file.json#/path). Preferred over $ref to avoid VS Code conflicts.

$merge.description: Alias for $include. Path to external JSON file, JSON pointer (#/path), or combined (file.json#/path).

$ref.description: Legacy alias for $include. May conflict with VS Code's own $ref handling.
